timing_semantics.native_diagnostic: Optional purpose-tagged native HiGHS method seconds are subsets of inclusive LP/geometry/volume times. Do not add to those times. HiGHS.run combines native presolve and solve.
timing_semantics.total: Original solve_problem result.seconds; includes per-problem session/pool startup and shutdown. Excludes imports, random instance generation and report checkpoint IO.
timing_semantics.wall_phases: Disjoint main-process wall intervals. State calls nested in compute are counted only in query planning.
timing_semantics.main_operation_timers: Inclusive helper-call perf_counter timers in the main process only; already part of wall phases.
timing_semantics.worker_operation_timers: Inclusive perf_counter timers, summed across actual worker tasks/processes. These are cumulative process wall seconds, not elapsed run time and not CPU seconds. Current ratio/exact/sampling/support categories are mutually non-overlapping within a task.
timing_semantics.ratio_intervals: Candidate optimality-region geometry, vertex enumeration, ratio bounds and optional candidate volume calculations.
timing_semantics.exact_volume_probabilities: Answer-support LP checks plus intrinsic volumes, vertex enumeration, volume cache and probability normalization.
timing_semantics.worker_other: Uninstrumented portions of active tasks, such as query construction/filtering, feasibility checks, recursive bookkeeping and terminal counts.
timing_semantics.cpu: process_time for main solve plus worker active tasks; excludes worker interpreter/import/startup and idle intervals.

profiling_overhead.measurement: Light perf_counter contexts/counters and small worker result payloads; no cProfile. Instrumentation overhead has not been quantified against an unprofiled control.
profiling_overhead.algorithm_modifications: Harness preserves source solve_problem; wraps session timing and pool worker results. Baseline and optimization source are supplied separately.

limitations: Three independent random problems per dimension are a small sample; cases across dimensions are not identical or paired.
The seeded generator is reset separately per dimension.
These instrumented current-version timings are a separate experiment from the unprofiled original/current paired comparison.
Raw evidence paths refer to the external output bundle; large profiles and logs are not embedded.
snapshot_scope: All nine exact inputs, complete chosen-query records, elapsed/per-query times, outcome and candidate-volume fields; task worker PIDs and disjoint phase totals. Root digests, redundant query-probability observer records, caches and profiles remain in SHA-identified raw reports.
